scoring_justification: The checker recomputes ω² and T from the provided k-points using the BCC dynamical matrix and Cardan's solution; T1 is feasible and preferred.

hidden_assets.purpose: dynamical matrix and Cardan's solution formulas (no stored gold values)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper equations for BCC lattice and Cardan's method
hidden_assets.generation_method: implementing standard algebraic formulas from paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The hidden gold is derived deterministically from the public problem setup and formulas; no invented data.

outputs.description: Squared phonon frequencies ω² and degeneracy parameter T along the [100] direction. The checker will recompute ω² and T from the provided kx values, verify that omega2_2 ≈ omega2_3 and T ≈ 0 (transverse branches degenerate), and compare all ω² values within a relative tolerance.

Squared phonon frequencies ω² and degeneracy parameter T along the non-symmetry direction [1,0.1,0.2]. The checker will recompute ω² and T from the provided (kx,ky,kz) values, verify that all ω² are positive, omega2_1 > omega2_2 > omega2_3, and T < 0, and compare all ω² values within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The checker independently implements the same BCC dynamical matrix (force constant ratio 0.8, lattice constant a=1) and Cardan's solution. It reads the agent's CSV, extracts the k-points, recomputes ω² and T, then checks agreement. No external data is required; the checker's hidden gold is its own recomputation.
